convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the Extremum indicator (custom indicator not available in standard MT5 builtins) and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution logic including position opens, closes, and global variable cleanup

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds used for signal timing
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation proceeds

long.left: Extremum UpValue[1] (previous bar upper extremum signal)
long.right: Extremum DnValue[0] (current bar lower extremum signal)

short.left: Extremum DnValue[1] (previous bar lower extremum signal)
short.right: Extremum UpValue[0] (current bar upper extremum signal)

other_exits: Buy position closed when sell signal appears (DnValue[1] is true)
Sell position closed when buy signal appears (UpValue[1] is true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values treated as deposit share fraction for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals use Extremum indicator buffers 3 (down extremum) and 5 (up extremum). Long entry requires UpValue[1] nonzero on previous bar AND DnValue[0] nonzero on current bar (confirmed extremum). Short entry requires DnValue[1] nonzero on previous bar AND UpValue[0] nonzero on current bar. SignalBar=0 forces recalculation every tick regardless of new bar. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation when CopyBuffer fails. Signal times are computed as last bar date + TimeShiftSec for trade execution timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen bools gate whether entries are allowed; BuyPosClose/SellPosClose bools gate whether signal-reversal exits are allowed.
python_conversion_notes: The Extremum custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python or its logic reverse-engineered from the .mq5 source. It uses 6 buffers minimum (buffers 3 and 5 are read). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all order execution (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) and must be fully reimplemented. Position sizing logic is conditional on the sign of MM: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction - must replicate this dual-mode behavior. SL/TP are specified in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment is needed, but the point-to-price conversion must account for the symbol's _Point value. The new bar guard uses CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh; replace with standard pandas bar detection.
